    pts=[(c*(x-v*dt)+s*y,-s*(x-v*dt)+c*y,side,age+dt) for x,y,side,age in pts if age<9]
    for name,side in [('left_mirror',1),('right_mirror',-1)]:
        view=obs['views'].get(name)
        if view:
            ox,oy=view['origin']
            for b,d in view['walls']:
                b=math.radians(b); x=ox+d*math.cos(b); y=oy+d*math.sin(b)
                if -20<x<-4 and side*y>0.6:
                    pts.append((x,y,side,0))

            den=sum(w*(x-mx)**2 for x,y,w in rows)
            slope=sum(w*(x-mx)*(y-my) for x,y,w in rows)/max(den,0.01)
